pages.title: Wels Catfish
pages.text: The wels catfish ($(o)Silurus glanis$()) lives in the large rivers and lakes of central and eastern Europe and western Asia.$(br2)It has a broad, flat head with a huge mouth, two long and four short whiskers, a tiny back fin and a very long fin under its tapering tail. It is mottled olive above and pale below.$(br2)In the River Tarn in France, some wels lunge onto the bank to catch pigeons, then slide back into the water.
